projects.name: ReQbert
projects.note: Semi-playable browser remake listed on osgameclones; development halted.

projects.name: QBert-Recreated
projects.note: Student-style Unity recreation, 5 stars.

qbert.official_modern: Q*bert Rebooted (2014, Sideline Amusements; PC/PS3/PS4/Vita), commercial, hexagon-based 3D remake with a classic mode.
qbert.gap_note: Only small, halted, pixel-faithful hobby clones exist; no free Q*bert with modern lighting/effects.

projects.name: Bombjack (rvretrogames)
projects.note: Mix of arcade and Amstrad CPC versions.

projects.name: Bomb Jack Remake (RADICALBLAST)
projects.note: Browser recreation of the arcade game.

projects.name: Bomb Jack remake (DOS, 2002)
projects.note: Old fan remake with smoother animation.

bombjack.official_modern: None; only emulated re-releases (e.g. arcade ROM collections).
bombjack.gap_note: Several freeware fan clones, all pixel-faithful and closed-source; nothing open-source or modern-looking.

projects.name: Head over Heels (dougmencken)
projects.note: Open-source continuation of Jorge Rodriguez Santos' 2003 remake (the Retrospec one) with redrawn hi-res isometric graphics.

projects.name: Head over Heels 2 (Helmantika)
projects.note: Original author's open-source release of his remake.

headoverheels.gap_note: An active GPL enhanced 2D remake with hi-res sprites exists, but it is a faithful 2000s-style remake, not a modern lit/particle presentation.

projects.name: Hedgewars
projects.last_activity: 2026 (repo activity; last major release 1.0.2 in 2022, unverified)
projects.note: Polished cartoon Worms-like with hedgehogs, map editor, online play; the de-facto free Worms.

projects.name: WarMUX (ex-Wormux)
projects.note: Worms clone with FOSS-mascot teams; last release 11.01 in Jan 2011.

worms.official_modern: Worms series continues commercially at Team17 (Worms W.M.D. 2016, Worms Rumble 2020, Worms Armageddon still sold).
worms.gap_note: Hedgewars is a mature, active, open 2D Worms-like with its own art, but it's a cartoon look, not a premium lit/particle presentation.

projects.name: Techmino
projects.note: Feature-rich modern-guideline block game with effects, many modes, BGM; strong community.

projects.name: OpenBlok
projects.note: Customizable, themeable falling-block game.

projects.name: NullpoMino
projects.note: Competitive/rule-configurable engine, dated visuals.

projects.name: tetris-spheres
projects.note: Small open-source 'Tetris Effect copycat' with artist-themed music/colors; proof of concept.

tetris.official_modern: Tetris Effect: Connected (2018/2021, Monstars/Resonair) is exactly the premium-modern benchmark; Tetris 99, Tetris Forever, many licensed versions. Note The Tetris Company enforces trade dress/trademark aggressively.
tetris.gap_note: Many polished open-source block games (Techmino) exist, but none with a Tetris Effect-level audio-visual presentation; legal/trade-dress risk is the main constraint.

projects.name: Castle-Combat
projects.note: Up to 4 players local/network Rampart clone.

projects.name: Kajaani Kombat
projects.note: Rampart-like with local and online multiplayer.

projects.name: RampartRemake (Thomarius)
projects.note: Brand-new vibe-coded multiplayer recreation (unverified quality).

rampart.official_modern: None; only arcade collections. Castle Chaos (2015, Steam) is a commercial Rampart-like.
rampart.gap_note: Only small halted or brand-new hobby clones with basic graphics; no modern-looking free Rampart.

northsouth.official_modern: The Bluecoats: North vs South (2012, Microids; iOS/Android/PC), North & South: The Game (2012, bitComposer, iOS), The Bluecoats: North & South (2020, Microids; Switch/PS4/XB1/PC) - all commercial and licensed from the comic.
northsouth.gap_note: No free or open-source recreation found; only commercial Microids remakes. Note the Les Tuniques Bleues comic licence would require a re-theme.

chaosengine.official_modern: The Chaos Engine (2013, Abstraction Games / Rebellion), commercial faithful remake for PC/Mac/Linux with HD options.
chaosengine.gap_note: No free fan clone found on GitHub, itch.io or osgameclones; only the commercial faithful remake exists.

projects.name: FreeSynd
projects.note: Reimplementation of the Syndicate engine; needs original game files.

projects.name: Syndicate Wars Fan Expansion (swars)
projects.note: Port of the 1996 sequel Syndicate Wars; needs original data.

syndicate.official_modern: Syndicate (2012, Starbreeze/EA) FPS reboot; Satellite Reign (2015, 5 Lives Studios) is the commercial spiritual successor.
syndicate.gap_note: Only engine ports requiring original data with original visuals; no free modern-looking Syndicate.

projects.name: OpenXcom
projects.note: Definitive engine reimplementation with huge mod scene; needs original UFO/TFTD data.

projects.name: OpenXcom Extended (OXCE)
projects.note: Extended fork powering total conversions like X-Com Files; some mods ship free art.

projects.name: UFO: Alien Invasion
projects.note: Full 3D X-COM-like on a Quake2-derived engine; 3D but dated visuals.

projects.name: OpenApoc
projects.note: Reimplementation of X-COM: Apocalypse (sequel), for reference.

xcom.official_modern: XCOM: Enemy Unknown (2012) and XCOM 2 (2016) by Firaxis; Xenonauts 1/2 and Phoenix Point are commercial spiritual successors.
xcom.gap_note: Gameplay is thoroughly covered by OpenXcom and UFO:AI, but no free version has modern premium visuals (OpenXcom uses 1994 art; UFO:AI's 3D dates from ~2010).

projects.name: CorsixTH
projects.note: Mature Theme Hospital engine reimplementation with level editor; needs original data.

themehospital.official_modern: Two Point Hospital (2018, Two Point Studios/Sega) is the commercial spiritual successor.
themehospital.gap_note: CorsixTH is excellent but uses the original 1997 sprites and needs original data; nothing free with its own modern visuals.

projects.name: Pang Zero
projects.last_activity: 2022 (Debian SDL port fork; original project ~2012, unverified)
projects.note: Super Pang clone/extension for up to 6-8 players.

pang.official_modern: Pang Adventures (2016, DotEmu), commercial HD remake on PC/consoles/mobile.
pang.gap_note: Only an old Perl/SDL clone with simple graphics; no free modern-looking Pang.

projects.name: Spy vs Spy - The Fuse and Ms Fire Files
projects.licence: freeware (fan game, uses MAD licensed characters)
projects.note: Fan remake with improved HUD/sprites; IP-infringing.

projects.name: spy-vs-spy (PierreZ)
projects.note: Small hobby recreation.

spyvsspy.official_modern: Spy vs. Spy (2005, Vicious Cycle; 3D, PS2/Xbox) and Spy vs. Spy (2012, Robots and Pencils; iOS/Android) - commercial, MAD Magazine licensed.
spyvsspy.gap_note: Only closed freeware fan projects and tiny hobby code; nothing open or modern. MAD's spy characters are licensed IP, so a remake needs original characters.

projects.name: XArchon
projects.note: Reimplementation of Archon: The Light and the Dark.

projects.name: Archon Remake
projects.note: Browser remake on SourceForge.

projects.name: Archon (heinrichelsigan)
projects.note: Android port of classic Archon.

archon.official_modern: Archon Ultra (1994, SSI) and Archon Classic (2008, Free Fall, Windows) - commercial.
archon.gap_note: Only retro-faithful, dormant hobby clones; no modern presentation of the board+arena concept.

projects.name: Planet M.U.L.E.
projects.note: Faithful remake with online multiplayer, ranking and forum, by Turborilla; not open source.

projects.name: mewl
projects.note: Unplayable open-source attempt.

mule.gap_note: Planet M.U.L.E. is a well-maintained free (closed) remake but visually modest 2D; no open-source or premium-looking version.

projects.name: Rodland (GreenSnake)
projects.note: JavaScript remake of the 8/16-bit versions, 1-2 players.

projects.name: Rod-Land (Lego Racers)
projects.note: 24-hour jam recreation.

rodland.official_modern: No remake; Retro-Bit released an NES cartridge edition (retro-bit.com/rodland) - a physical re-release, not a modern remake.
rodland.gap_note: Only tiny pixel-faithful fan clones; nothing open or modern.

fireice.gap_note: No free recreation found at all (GitHub, itch.io, osgameclones searched).

projects.name: OpenVikings
projects.note: Reverse-engineered rewrite of the DOS version.

projects.name: LostVikings (akaWolf)
projects.note: Decompiled DOS executable wrapped in SDL2; needs original DATA.DAT.

projects.name: freeVikings
projects.note: Playable clone with its own graphics and levels.

projects.name: lost-vikings-remake (Furyspark)
projects.note: Small HTML5 remake attempt.

lostvikings.official_modern: Blizzard Arcade Collection (2021) re-releases The Lost Vikings (emulated, with rewind); no modern remake.
lostvikings.gap_note: Only engine ports needing original data and old hobby clones; no free modern-looking version of the three-hero puzzle-platformer.

projects.name: Frog (Almost There Games)
projects.note: Reimplementation needing original Amiga disks; widescreen, hi-res, controller, CRT filter, original pixel art.

projects.name: Superfrog (SourceForge)
projects.note: Resource-collection project for an open remake; never completed.

superfrog.official_modern: Superfrog HD (2013, Team17; PS Vita/PC), commercial.
superfrog.gap_note: The only live free project is a data-requiring reimplementation with original pixel art; nothing open with new modern visuals.

projects.name: Scorched3D
projects.note: Full 3D terrain version of Scorched Earth with online play; 3D but 2000s-era visuals.

projects.name: Atomic Tanks
projects.note: Classic 2D remake with hotseat play.

projects.name: Scorched Earth 2000 HTML port
projects.note: JavaScript port of the Java Scorched Earth 2000.

scorchedearth.official_modern: None official; Pocket Tanks / ShellShock Live are commercial spiritual successors.
scorchedearth.gap_note: Many open clones incl. a 3D one (Scorched3D), but all dormant and visually dated; no modern premium free version.

projects.name: Dust Racing 2D
projects.note: Top-down racer with split-screen and level editor; clean 2D, not toy-themed.

projects.name: Yorg
projects.note: 3D top-down car combat racer with online/local multiplayer.

projects.name: Microracers
projects.note: Semi-playable Micro Machines-like.

micromachines.official_modern: Micro Machines World Series (2017, Codemasters), commercial 3D.
micromachines.gap_note: Dust Racing 2D is a solid, active, open top-down racer, but none has the toy-scale household tracks or a premium modern look.
